first_sql:
SELECT 
    a.F002V AS `股票简称`,
    a.F003V AS `英文名称`,
    a.COMB_SYMBOL AS `股票代码`,
    ROUND(b.CLOSE_PRICE, 2) AS `最新收盘价(美元)`,
    b.TRADE_DATE AS `行情日期`,
    ROUND(c.`市盈率`, 2) AS `市盈率`
FROM (
    SELECT 
        FIU_ID,
        F002V,
        F003V,
        COMB_SYMBOL
    FROM AMERICAN_STOCK_MAIN
    WHERE COMB_SYMBOL IN ('XOM.US', 'CVX.US')
) a
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 
        FIU_ID, 
        CLOSE_PRICE, 
        TRADE_DATE
    FROM VIEW_US_EXPR_IDX
    WHERE TRADE_DATE = (
        SELECT MAX(TRADE_DATE) FROM VIEW_US_EXPR_IDX
        WHERE COMB_SYMBOL IN ('XOM.US', 'CVX.US')
    )
) b
    ON a.FIU_ID = b.FIU_ID
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 
        t1.FIU_ID,
        CASE 
            WHEN (t2.EPS_TTM IS NOT NULL AND t2.EPS_TTM != 0) THEN 
                t1.CLOSE_PRICE / t2.EPS_TTM
            ELSE NULL
        END AS `市盈率`
    FROM 
        (SELECT 
             FIU_ID, 
             CLOSE_PRICE, 
             TRADE_DATE 
         FROM VIEW_US_EXPR_IDX 
         WHERE TRADE_DATE = (
             SELECT MAX(TRADE_DATE) FROM VIEW_US_EXPR_IDX 
             WHERE COMB_SYMBOL IN ('XOM.US', 'CVX.US')
         )
        ) t1
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT 
            FIU_ID, 
            SUM(F016N) OVER (PARTITION BY FIU_ID ORDER BY F001D ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS EPS_TTM
        FROM VIEW_COM3103_Q
        WHERE F016N IS NOT NULL 
          AND F001D IN (
              SELECT DISTINCT F001D
              FROM VIEW_COM3103_Q
              WHERE F001D <= (SELECT MAX(F001D) FROM VIEW_COM3103_Q)
          )
    ) t2
        ON t1.FIU_ID = t2.FIU_ID
) c
    ON a.FIU_ID = c.FIU_ID
ORDER BY c.`市盈率` ASC
